metadata.name: bullxi
metadata.description: BULL-XI: fantasy league for onchain stocks

instructions.name: buy_squad
docs: Invests `amount` test dollars in the player's 15-stock squad, equal
dollars per stock, at the latest price-book prices (same rollup).

instructions.name: claim_test_dollars
docs: Credits the one-time test dollars and makes the portfolio private:
only the player (and the game crank) can read balances and holdings.

instructions.name: commit_price_book
docs: Commits the current price book from the rollup to Solana.

instructions.name: configure
docs: Admin can rotate the pusher key (and grow the list of stocks).

instructions.name: create_entry
docs: Creates an empty entry on Solana and pre-funds the rent of its privacy
permission. The squad itself is never sent to Solana before kickoff.

instructions.name: create_gameweek
docs: Admin or crank creates a gameweek on Solana. kind 0 = daily (24h), 1 = flash (1h).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Admin or crank

instructions.name: create_league
docs: Creates a friends league for one gameweek on Solana. `fee` is the entry
fee in test dollars (0 = free); every fee goes into the league's pot.

instructions.name: create_manager
docs: Creates a manager's public profile on Solana. A sponsor may pay.

instructions.name: create_portfolio
docs: Creates a player's Pro portfolio on Solana (a sponsor may pay) and
pre-funds the rent of its privacy permission.

instructions.name: delegate_manager
docs: Hands the profile to the private rollup, where settlement updates it.

instructions.name: delegate_price_book
docs: Delegates the price book (pass the validator identity as the first remaining account).

instructions.name: golden_callback
docs: VRF callback, signed by this program's scoped VRF identity only.
Draws the golden stock uniformly among the stocks started this week.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Game config on Solana: who may create gameweeks, and the crank that settles them.

instructions.name: init_price_book
docs: Creates the price book on Solana. `pusher` is the only key allowed to write prices.

instructions.name: join_league
docs: Joins before the gameweek deadline. Paid leagues move the fee from the
player's portfolio into the pot, inside the rollup.

accounts.name: portfolio
docs: Needed only for paid leagues

instructions.name: push_prices
docs: Writes the latest prices (micro-USD, 0 = no update for that stock)
and advances every stock's price x time sum. Runs on the rollup.

instructions.name: request_golden
docs: After kickoff, asks MagicBlock VRF for randomness to draw the golden
stock. Anyone can call it once (or retry after VRF_RETRY_SECS).

instructions.name: reveal_entry
docs: After kickoff anyone can reveal a sealed entry: it becomes public in the rollup.

instructions.name: schedule_ticks
docs: Schedules a MagicBlock crank on the rollup that calls tick_gameweek
every `interval_ms` for `iterations` runs. No server needed for snapshots.

instructions.name: seal_entry
docs: Seals (or re-seals) the manager's squad inside the private rollup before
the deadline. The entry becomes readable only by the manager and the crank.

instructions.name: sell_all
docs: Sells every holding back to test dollars at the latest prices.

instructions.name: set_profile
docs: Renames the manager or team. Runs on the rollup.

instructions.name: settle_entry
docs: Scores a revealed entry from the gameweek's TWAPs, adds it to the
manager's season, and commits both to Solana in the same transaction.

instructions.name: settle_league
docs: After full time, pays the pot to the member with the most points (ties:
first to join). Remaining accounts: each member's entry for the gameweek,
then, for paid leagues, each member's portfolio, in join order.
If nobody played, paid fees go back. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: snapshot_gameweek
docs: Moves a gameweek through its TWAP snapshots. Anyone can call it once the
time has come; it reads the price book in the same rollup.
OPEN -> KICKED_OFF (at deadline) -> LIVE (opening TWAP) -> CLOSING -> FINAL (closing TWAP).

instructions.name: tick_gameweek
docs: Same as snapshot_gameweek but never fails when nothing is due, so a
MagicBlock crank (ScheduleTask) can call it on a timer.

instructions.name: undelegate_price_book
docs: Commits and hands the price book back to Solana (admin only), e.g. to move rollups.

errors.name: NotPusher
errors.msg: Only the price pusher can do this

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the admin can do this

errors.name: BadSchedule
errors.msg: End must be after the deadline

errors.name: SquadQuota
errors.msg: Squad needs 2 ETF, 5 Blue Chip, 5 Growth and 3 High Risk

errors.name: OverBudget
errors.msg: Squad is over the 100 credit budget

errors.name: LineupMismatch
errors.msg: Starters and bench must be your 15 stocks

errors.name: Captain
errors.msg: Captain and vice must be two different starters

errors.name: Chip
errors.msg: That chip can't be played like this

errors.name: TooSmall
errors.msg: Invest at least $15 (one dollar per stock)

errors.name: NoPrice
errors.msg: A stock has no price yet

errors.name: BadFee
errors.msg: Entry fee must be at most $100

errors.name: NeedsPortfolio
errors.msg: Paid leagues need a Pro portfolio

fields.name: crank
docs: Key that reveals and settles entries (can read sealed entries)

fields.name: window
docs: Length of the opening and closing TWAP windows, seconds

fields.name: tmp_ts
docs: Price book state saved at the start of the current window

fields.name: open_twap
docs: Opening and closing TWAP per stock, micro-USD

fields.name: picked
docs: Bitmask of every stock started by a sealed squad this gameweek

fields.name: top_gainer
docs: Biggest TWAP gainer among `picked`, set at full time (255 = none)

fields.name: golden
docs: Golden stock drawn by MagicBlock VRF after kickoff (255 = none yet)

fields.name: vrf_state
docs: VRF request state (none, requested, fulfilled) and when it was requested

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for future fields without moving gameweeks again

fields.name: fee
docs: Entry fee and pot, micro-USD test dollars

fields.name: status
docs: 0 = open, 1 = settled

fields.name: cash
docs: Test dollars not invested, micro-USD

fields.name: invested
docs: Dollars put into the current holdings (cost basis), micro-USD

fields.name: shares
docs: Holdings per stock, micro-shares

fields.name: updates
docs: Number of pushes so far

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Unix seconds of the first and the latest push

fields.name: prices
docs: Latest price per stock, micro-USD (1 USD = 1_000_000)

fields.name: cum
docs: Running sum of price x seconds since start_ts, per stock

fields.name: first_ts
docs: When each stock got its first price, if it joined after start_ts (else 0)
